tools.name: create_ariel_search
tools.summary: Create a new asynchronous Ariel search using an AQL query expression or a saved search ID.
tools.description:
Create a new asynchronous Ariel search using an AQL query expression or a saved search ID. Returns a UUID search_id string used to monitor status and retrieve results via get_ariel_search_status and get_ariel_search_results.

NOTE: saved_search_id is an INTEGER from list_saved_searches — it is NOT the UUID search_id string returned by this tool or get_ariel_search_status.

IMPORTANT: Before using this tool with a query_expression:
1. Read qradar://aql/fields/events or qradar://aql/fields/flows to get valid field names
2. Read qradar://aql/functions to discover available functions
3. Read qradar://aql/guide for syntax rules and patterns
4. Use validate_aql tool to check query syntax before execution

This workflow prevents errors and ensures queries use correct field names for this QRadar deployment.

query_expression.description: The AQL query to execute (e.g., 'SELECT sourceip, destinationip FROM events LAST 1 HOURS'). Mutually exclusive with saved_search_id.

saved_search_id.description: Integer ID of a saved Ariel search to execute. Get this integer from list_saved_searches or get_saved_search. Mutually exclusive with query_expression.

tools.effect_meaning: creates a temporary search job that reads data (consumes search capacity)
tools.basis: POST ariel/searches creates an Ariel search job that reads events/flows; results expire upstream
tools.output: json_text
tools.dependencies: QRadar user with Log Activity/Network Activity capability; searches consume Ariel capacity

tools.name: create_dsm_event_mapping
tools.summary: Create a new custom DSM event mapping in QRadar.
tools.description:
Create a new custom DSM event mapping in QRadar.

DSM event mappings link raw log source event identifiers to QID records so that
QRadar can classify incoming events. This creates a user-provided (custom) mapping.

log_source_type_id.description: The ID of the log source type this mapping is associated with. Get this from list_log_source_types

log_source_event_id.description: The primary identifying value parsed from an event (e.g., event type string)

log_source_event_category.description: The secondary identifying value parsed from an event

qid_record_id.description: The ID of the QID record to map matching events to. Get this from list_qid_records, get_qid_record, or get_qid_record_by_qid

fields.description: Optional comma-separated list of fields to return in the response

tools.effect_meaning: creates, changes or deletes state in the product or on managed assets
tools.output: json_text
tools.dependencies: QRadar user with DSM editor/QID read capability

tools.name: create_qid_record
tools.summary: Create a new QID record in QRadar.
tools.description:
Create a new QID record in QRadar.

QID records define custom event types in QRadar. Creating a QID record allows custom
events from log sources to be classified with a specific name, category, and severity.

log_source_type_id.description: The ID of the log source type this QID record is created for. Get this from list_log_source_types

name.description: The human-readable name for the event type

low_level_category_id.description: The low level category ID to classify this event type. Get this from list_low_level_categories or get_low_level_category

description.description: Optional description of the event type

severity.description: Optional severity override (0-10). Defaults to the low level category's severity.

fields.description: Optional comma-separated list of fields to return in the response

tools.effect_meaning: creates, changes or deletes state in the product or on managed assets
tools.output: json_text
tools.dependencies: QRadar user with DSM editor/QID read capability

availableActions
	

Allows you to select the discoverable endpoints that may require attention.
	

    immediateActionRequired: An issue occurred on the endpoint that requires user intervention.

    unmanaged: The endpoints are discoverable on your network but do not have any available protection or sensor agent program installed.

    sensorUpdateRequired: The endpoint has an older version of the Endpoint Sensor component installed (including Activity Monitoring and Apex One Endpoint Sensor) and should update to the latest Trend Vision One version.

    sepMaintenanceRecommended: The Standard Endpoint Protection endpoint does not have XDR Endpoint Sensor. The Detection and Response feature is off.

    a1MaintenanceRecommended: The Apex One endpoint does not have XDR Endpoint Sensor. The Detection and Response feature is off.

    swpMaintenanceRecommended: The Server & Workload Protection endpoint does not have XDR Endpoint Sensor. The Detection and Response feature is off.

    c1MaintenanceRecommended: The Cloud One endpoint does not have XDR Endpoint Sensor. The Detection and Response feature is off.

    sensorDisabled: The Managed Endpoint and Detection and Response features are off. The endpoint has XDR Endpoint Sensor.

securityDeployment
	

Allows you to select the endpoints that have a protection or sensor agent installed.
	

    managed: All endpoints on your network that have a protection or sensor agent installed

    userProtection: All endpoints that have the Standard Endpoint Protection agent installed (includes endpoints that also have the Endpoint sensor detection and response feature enabled)

    workloadProtection: All endpoints that have the Server & Workload agent installed (includes endpoints that also have the Endpoint sensor detection and response feature enabled)

    sensorOnly: All endpoints that only have the Sensor agent installed (endpoints that are not protected by a Standard Endpoint Protection or Server & Workload Protection agent)
